title: Solutions Analyst
description:
HM126: Solutions Analyst

Location: Hybrid/ London once every 2 weeks but flexible

Contract: 6 Months possible extension

Salary: Competitive Day Rate | Inside IR35

Overview:

First Military Recruitment are currently seeking a Solutions Analyst on behalf of one of our clients.

Our client encourages applications from ex-military personnel however all candidates will be given due consideration.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • As an Azure AI Solution Engineer, you will be a technical practitioner responsible for building, fine-tuning, and integrating advanced Artificial Intelligence and machine learning solutions in Microsoft Azure.
  • This position is focused on hands-on implementation, coding and solution integration.
  • You will directly build and deploy production-grade AI pipelines, generative AI applications and anomaly detection models to analyse documents for AI generation, manipulation and fraud.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Azure AI Native Stack: Deep hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Foundry, Azure Cognitive Services (Document Intelligence) and Azure Databricks.
  • Core Languages: Fluency in Python and SQL.
  • GenAI Tooling: Hands-on experience constructing enterprise RAG apps using LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases and Azure AI Search.
  • MLOps & CI/CD: Practical setup of MLflow, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker and Terraform/Bicep.
  • Minimum of BPSS Security Clearance.

Desirable:

  • Fraud & Risk Analytics: Practical experience using AI to detect fraud e.g. specifically tuning models for anomaly detection, graph network linkages or financial crime patterns.
  • UK Public Sector Context: Working knowledge of GDS Service Standards, CDDO AI guidelines and secure data handling under UK GDPR / Official Sensitive guidelines.
  • Clearance: Active Security Check (SC) clearance (or immediate eligibility).
  • Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100).
